page_title: LIV 4-1 CHE | Liverpool v Chelsea 31/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Chelsea can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+6' Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
90+4' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
90+3' A snap shot by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Djordje Petrovic produces a good save to thwart him.
90+2' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is able to continue to play.
87' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
86' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Darwin Nunez, but Djordje Petrovic displays great awareness to stop him.
86' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 27:4.
85' Mauricio Pochettino prepares a substitution. Cole Palmer is replaced by Cesare Casadei (Chelsea).

84' That didn't go as planned! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Djordje Petrovic, who easily kept it out.
83' Dangerous play by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea). Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
83' A substitution has been made. Curtis Jones goes off and Bobby Clark (Liverpool) comes on.
82' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
81' The game is interrupted. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
79' 4 - 1 Goal! Darwin Nunez plays a pass to the feet of Luis Diaz (Liverpool), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 4:1.
77' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
76' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Paul Tierney didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
76' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
76' Djordje Petrovic had to pull off an exquisite save to thwart a knuckleball from Harvey Elliott (Liverpool), even though it only went towards the middle of the target.

75' Crossbar! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!

73' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the right-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it.
73' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
71' 3 - 1 Carney Chukwuemeka plays a neat ball into the path of Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea), who makes room for a shot and sends in a low drive which bounces in off the right post! 3:1.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch for Joe Gomez.
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is replacing Dominik Szoboszlai.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Diogo Jota will be replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
68' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) replaces Conor Bradley.
68' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
66' Here comes a substitution. Moises Caicedo is given a rest as he is replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea).
65' 3 - 0 Goal! Conor Bradley is the provider and Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the middle of the goal from close in with his head. 3:0.
63' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) commits a foul and Paul Tierney immediately signals a free kick.
62' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.

62' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Djordje Petrovic was alert and the score remains the same.
60' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
60' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
59' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

59' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
58' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Paul Tierney signals. Liverpool are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
57' The linesman signals that Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
56' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

56' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
55' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Darwin Nunez, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
54' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Paul Tierney who sees an offensive foul.
53' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Djordje Petrovic stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
52' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

51' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.

51' Alisson doesn't have to worry about this one. Malo Gusto plays a pass into the feet of Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
49' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is caught offside!
49' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alisson is quickest to intercept the ball.
48' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
48' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Now Liverpool have a corner.
47' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
47' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) heads on.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) comes off for Malo Gusto.
46' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Conor Gallagher will be replaced by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is replaced by Mykhailo Mudryk.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+5' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.

45+3' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Alisson!
45+3' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+2' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
45+2' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+1' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Paul Tierney couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) and blew his whistle. Liverpool are given a penalty!
44' The resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared by the defence.
44' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
42' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
41' Paul Tierney shows the yellow card to Axel Disasi (Chelsea) for a heavy challenge.
41' Referee Paul Tierney points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Liverpool players celebrate.
40' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Liverpool players aren’t happy.
39' 2 - 0 Conor Bradley (Liverpool) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
38' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is flagged for offside.
35' Paul Tierney has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
35' This is a yellow card! Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
34' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.

33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Paul Tierney didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Liverpool earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
32' A lofted pass finds Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.

31' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Djordje Petrovic thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
29' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
28' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
27' The foul by Noni Madueke (Chelsea) was seen by Paul Tierney who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
26' Paul Tierney sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
25' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Liverpool players aren’t happy.

23' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Diogo Jota (Liverpool) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 1:0. Djordje Petrovic was helpless.

21' What a chance that is! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
21' The corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is intercepted by Djordje Petrovic.

21' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Liverpool get a corner.
21' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
20' A cross, provided by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger.

20' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Paul Tierney blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Liverpool in a dangerous position.
19' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

18' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and fires towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly and tips the ball onto the post. That was a fantastic reflex save! Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
15' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
15' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
15' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
14' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
13' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.
13' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.

11' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is booked for saying more than Paul Tierney was willing to tolerate. Liverpool have a free kick.
10' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and signals a foul after Conor Bradley (Liverpool) brought his opponent down.
9' The referee blows his whistle as Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) was too aggressive in his challenge.
9' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender.
9' The corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is hurriedly cleared.

8' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) collects a pass, finds some space and strikes a spinning ball from far out towards the roof of the net. It's a tough one for the keeper, but he brilliantly gets a glove to it and deflects it onto the crossbar. Liverpool earn a corner.
7' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
6' PENALTY APPEAL after Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
6' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Djordje Petrovic.
5' Flag goes up against Cole Palmer (Chelsea) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
4' Some great controlled play and passing from Liverpool. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Alisson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
2' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Liverpool will kick the game off.
Paul Tierney is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
